summary: Lowered the go.mod Go directive from 1.26.7 to 1.26.6 to match the library CI toolchain.
reason: Generation ran on a host whose local Go was older than the generator binary, so GOTOOLCHAIN=auto resolved 1.26.7 and stamped it into go.mod. The public library pins .go-version to 1.26.6 and runs GOTOOLCHAIN=local, so the module could not load and Govulncheck failed with 'go.mod requires go >= 1.26.7'. 1.26.6 also carries the stdlib fixes the scan requires.
validated_outcome: go build, full test suite, and govulncheck all pass under a 1.26.6 toolchain; govulncheck reports no vulnerabilities.
